name: Road double crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 908 g for FC-RS510, 170 mm arms with 50/34T chainrings, excluding the bottom bracket. The handbook’s weight heading explicitly specifies 170 mm without BB. The reference has a 110 mm bolt circle and a 4-arm spider. The manufacturer range chart explicitly excludes compatibility with FD-5800.
